title: Query Scopes: Local aur Global
objectives: Local scope se reusable query conditions banana
Global scope ka idea samajhna aur use hata sakna
prerequisites: Create, Update, Delete aur Mass Assignment (m07-l03)

sections.heading: Scope kya hota hai?
sections.body: Agar `where('is_active', true)` jaisi condition har jagah dohrani pad rahi hai, to use model mein ek naam do. Is naam ko **scope** kehte hain. Isse code saaf aur ek hi jagah badalne layak hota hai.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Local scope
sections.body: Model mein `scope` prefix ke saath method likho. Use karte waqt prefix hata do.
explain: `scopeActive` ko `Product::active()` likhte ho (prefix `scope` hat jaata hai).
Scopes chain ho sakte hain aur baaki query methods ke saath mil sakte hain.
Scope ka pehla argument `Builder $query` Laravel khud deta hai, baaki parameters tum dete ho.

callout.text: Naye Laravel docs mein local scope ke liye ek `#[Scope]` attribute wala tareeka bhi dikhta hai. `scopeXxx` prefix wala tareeka sab versions mein chalta hai, isliye hum wahi seekh rahe hain.

sections.heading: Global scope
sections.body: Global scope har query mein apne aap lagta hai. Jaise soft deletes ka `deleted_at IS NULL`. Apna global scope bhi bana sakte ho.

code.code:
<?php

namespace App\Models\Scopes;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Scope;

class ActiveScope implements Scope
{
    public function apply(Builder $builder, Model $model): void
    {
        $builder->where('is_active', true);
    }
}

explain: `#[ScopedBy([...])]` model par global scope lagata hai. Isi ka purana tareeka `booted()` mein `static::addGlobalScope(new ActiveScope)` hai.
Admin panel jaisi jagah par `withoutGlobalScope()` se hata sakte ho.

callout.text: Global scopes dikhte nahi, isliye 'record kahan gaya?' wala confusion ho sakta hai. Zarurat ho tabhi lagao, aur zyada tar kaam ke liye local scope kaafi hai.

errors.cause: Scope method ka naam `scopeActive` nahi hai, ya model mein bana hi nahi.

errors.error: Records gayab hain (query khali aa rahi hai)
errors.cause: Koi global scope (jaise ActiveScope ya SoftDeletes) filter laga raha hai.

errors.fix: Scope file/model ke upar sahi `use` jodo.

options: Sirf ek query par lagta hai
Model ki har query mein apne aap lagta hai
quiz.why: Global scope har query mein automatically lagta hai.

quiz.q: Global scope ko hatane ke liye?

interview.a: Model ke andar reusable query condition, jise `Model::scopeName()` se call karte hain.

interview.q: Local aur global scope mein farak?
interview.a: Local scope tum khud chain karte ho. Global scope har query mein automatically lagta hai.

interview.q: Soft deletes kaise kaam karta hai?
interview.a: `SoftDeletes` ek global scope jodta hai jo `deleted_at IS NULL` wali rows hi laata hai.
Query logic ek jagah rehta hai, code padhne mein saaf hota hai aur dohrana nahi padta.
Jab behaviour chhupa hua confusion paida kare. Wahan local scope behtar hai.

summary: Global scope har query mein lagta hai, `withoutGlobalScope` se hat jaata hai.
`#[ScopedBy]` ya `addGlobalScope()` se global scope lagate hain.
Zyada tar kaam ke liye local scope kaafi hai.
